# FillMyCourt

FillMyCourt is a revenue-first B2B SaaS platform for racket clubs.

## Core entity
- Canonical domain: https://fillmycourt.com/
- Primary buyer: racket-club owners, general managers, operators and multi-location administrators.
- Primary commercial promise: recover incremental revenue from existing courts and player demand without adding a dedicated daily CRM/marketing operator.
- Core differentiator: a proprietary Demand Engine that connects court inventory, behavioural player intelligence, booking, activation and euro-level attribution.
- Core modules: automated player CRM, native booking and inventory, match formation, multi-channel activation, payments/membership path, distribution connectors, analytics, media-provider integrations and multi-location control.
- Current entry offer: Revenue Leak Audit, EUR 490, five business days.
- Current pilot hypothesis: EUR 1,250 setup + EUR 249/month + 8% of agreed attributed uplift.

## Product architecture
1. Revenue Map — value weak slots, cancellations, incomplete games and other addressable inventory.
2. Audience Intelligence — use authorised behavioural signals such as recency, frequency, value, preferred times, level and partners.
3. Decision Layer — prioritise opportunity, timing, channel and intervention intensity; scoring weights and rules remain proprietary.
4. Activation — run configured WhatsApp/SMS/email/push/booking-link workflows subject to consent and channel availability.
5. Attribution & Learning — reconcile bookings, incentives, fees, refunds and displacement against the agreed baseline.

## Booking and distribution
- FillMyCourt can operate a native booking core.
- Existing discovery/booking platforms can remain acquisition channels where authorised connectivity exists.
- External connectivity depends on APIs, exports, contracts and provider/customer permissions; provider names do not imply live integrations or partnerships.
- The strategy is not anti-marketplace: acquire broadly, then increase direct repeat demand where lawful, technically possible and economically sensible.

## Player-facing surfaces
- FillMyCourt remains the B2B operating/revenue brand.
- Clubs can offer a white-label player app/web experience, optionally labelled “Powered by FillMyCourt”.
- A separate international cross-club consumer booking/discovery brand is planned; its permanent brand name is not yet selected.
- Portable player identity/public attributes must remain separate from each club's private CRM history, spend, lifecycle segmentation and internal notes.

## Media & performance
FillMyCourt is designed to connect specialist sports-video providers to the booking/player/match record for live streams, replay, scoring, analysis, highlights and shareable clips where the provider supports them. Current public provider references are integration targets/examples, not partnership claims.

## Languages and markets
- Portuguese (pt-PT): primary Portugal market.
- English: international / UK / Nordic / cross-border business.
- Spanish (es-ES): priority expansion market because Spain is the world's largest padel market and a mature operating market where club utilisation, retention and revenue optimisation matter more than simply building more courts.
- Latvian (lv-LV): dedicated Baltic sales/localisation layer, including Latvia partner and operator discussions.
- Language switching is available persistently on desktop and mobile.
